items.title: Best Buy (BBY) Appoints Anne Bramman As CFO For Its Next Growth Push
items.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) has appointed Anne Bramman as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President. Bramman is scheduled to assume the role on August 19, 2026. She brings experience from senior finance and analytics roles at Nordstrom, Circana, Avery Dennison, and Carnival Cruise Line. Best Buy enters this leadership change with its stock at $85.25 and a mixed performance profile. items.title: Best Buy picks Nordstrom alum for CFO
items.summary: Anne Bramman succeeds Matt Bilunas, who left the retailer last month after serving as its finance chief for seven years.

items.title: Why Best Buy (BBY) Stock Is Down Today
items.summary: Shares of electronics retailer Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) fell 2.8% in the afternoon session after BofA Securities resumed coverage on the stock with an underperform rating.
